Deal Performance — DSP ▸ Domain ▸ Seat ▸ Deal by Date i
SQL Query 
SELECT 'Web' AS product, CAST(date AS date) AS date, channel_id AS dsp_group_name,
       buyer_id AS curator_seat, deal_name, deal_id, adomain AS domain_channel,
       SUM(seedtag_revenue) AS spend_usd, SUM(total_response_bids) AS requests_bids,
       SUM(total_impressions) AS impressions,
       IF(SUM(total_impressions)=0, NULL, SUM(seedtag_revenue)*1000.0/SUM(total_impressions)) AS cpm_usd,
       IF(SUM(total_impressions)=0, NULL, SUM(total_clicks)*1.0/SUM(total_impressions)) AS ctr
FROM st_datalakehouse.analytics.etl_ssp_responses_daily_enriched
WHERE date >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND date < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-13'
  AND LOWER(deal_name) LIKE '%multilocal%'
  AND source_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'Beachfront' AND channel_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'Beachfront'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

UNION ALL

SELECT 'CTV', date, dsp_group_name, seat_id, deal_name, deal_id, adomain,
       SUM(revenue), SUM(total_response_bids), SUM(total_impressions),
       IF(SUM(total_impressions)=0, NULL, SUM(revenue)*1000.0/SUM(total_impressions)),
       CAST(NULL AS double)
FROM st_datalakehouse.analytics.reporting_closing_bfm_demand
WHERE date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND date < DATE '2026-08-13'
  AND clearvu_account = 'MultiLocal'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
ORDER BY product, date, spend_usd DESC
-- Note: Web rows in this dashboard are post-aggregated to top-50 adomains by spend (rest = 'Other').

Metrics:
Web rows are aggregated to the top 50 advertiser domains by spend over the reporting period; all remaining domains are grouped as “Other”.
Analytics Team · Multilocal Curator Deal Performance · Aug 1 – Aug 12, 2026
Spend = Gross Revenue (USD). Requests = demand-side bids. Web = deals named Multilocal on the SSP responses table (Beachfront excluded); CTV = ClearVu account 'MultiLocal' on the Beachfront closing table. CTR not available for CTV. Bids Won and VCR are not available.
